Refunds will be subject to the deduction of the total amount of activities used and calculated at the current pay as you play rate, plus a Â£20 admin charge.

You will be given an authorisation ticket that will allow you to participate in your activity. Wherever possible please inform us if you are unable to attend a booked activity at least 24 hours before. CLL reserves the right to withdraw the booking privilege from a member should repeated non attendance to booked activities occur.

Replacement Cards

If your card has been lost or stolen please inform your home centre as soon as possible. There is a standard charge of Â£2.50 for a replacement card.

Data Protection

All personal information about you will be treated as private and confidential. Terms:
Facility Terms & Conditions

Terms & Conditions of use for all Richings Sports Park (RSP) gym members

• All members are responsible for complying with the following terms & conditions, which are in place for the enjoyment and safety of RSP members and staff.

 • RSP facilities should be used in accordance to the gym etiquette displayed.

• Access codes are issued to each member of gym with the following conditions:

1. Access codes must be entered for entry to the ground floor corridor, gym corridor and the gym.

2. Access codes are not transferable and may only be used by the person who they have been issued to.

3. RSP will change these codes as and when necessary. Prior to any new code being issued membership will be checked.

4. RSP reserves the right to check membership at any time and visit. • RSP reserves the right to make changes to the programming of the facilities.

• RSP endeavour to ensure that all facilities, classes and equipment are available during the advertised opening times. However, occasionally, due to circumstances beyond our control, facilities or equipment may be unavailable or classes cancelled. These circumstances have been calculated within the membership fees.

• RSP membership Direct Debit contracts offer an easy monthly payment scheme. The cost is spread over 12 monthly instalments, the payments are collected by third party Debit Finance Collections (DFC). A member may pay the remaining balance of their contract at any time. This is a rolling contract and payments continue into month 13 and beyond without a price increase. The member must notify DFC with 1 month notice that they wish to cancel. The contract does not automatically terminate after the twelfth payment.

• RSP has a planned redecoration programme for our gyms. During these periods it may be necessary to restrict access to the gyms for a small period of time. We are unable to refund memberships during any such period. Whilst we recognise this can be an inconvenience we would encourage alternatives to your exercise routine.

• Minimum age for membership to RSP is 16 years. Please note any members between 16-17 years of age signing up to a direct debit will require third party consent. Members of this age signing up to an annual up front membership do so at their own consent.

• Cancellations Annual memberships cannot be cancelled prior to the expiry date/or twelfth payment has been made. If, in extreme circumstances the contract cannot be fulfilled it can be transferred to another person. If due to relocation (minimum distance 5 miles from RSP) membership can be cancelled, providing sufficient proof. A contract may be cancelled once the twelfth payment has been made, this requires 1 month’s notice in writing to DFC (e-mail info@debitfinance.co.uk). A confirmation letter will be sent back. Queries on cancelled memberships can only be dealt with when a copy of this letter is provided. Contact DFC customer service on 01908 422007 for further enquires. In the unfortunate circumstance of members becoming redundant, RSP will review membership status on an individual basis providing sufficient proof.

• Annual up front memberships cannot be refunded under any circumstances.

• Frozen Payments. Payments may be frozen providing valid proof where the user is unable to use any of the facilities for a minimum period of 1 month, minimum notice period 14 days before next payment due. You will receive a letter from RSP confirming the duration that your membership is frozen and when payment will be taken out again. Queries on frozen memberships can only be dealt with when a copy of this letter is provided. During the life of a RSP membership the contract can only be frozen for a maximum of six months.

• Explanation of other costs Pro Rata (non refundable) – This payment covers the cost of using the facilities straight away, until the first payment is made. Admin Fee (non refundable) - £25. This is the charge for setting up the membership and contract process, and any costs throughout the life of membership.

• Banning The management reserve the right to terminate or temporarily suspend the membership of any person breaching rules and regulations, or for any other reason the management team deems appropriate. During suspension the member will continue to be charged membership fees

. • Screening – Health Commitment Statement I have read and agree to the terms of the Health Commitment Statement (HCS) – see below.

• Induction & Freestyle All gym users are required to attend a gym induction. However, experienced gym users are not required for an induction if they do not deem it necessary.

• Discounted Membership If you are a member of an associated sports club at RSP, or a RSP social member, you are entitled to a discounted gym membership. You must provide necessary proof of this membership when joining and this may be asked for again at a later date. If you cease to be a member of the associated sports club at RSP your gym fees will revert back to the standard rate automatically.

• General Information No food or drink may be brought into and consumed within RSP with the exception to drinking water, or with permission from the management. All users of RSP must observe the rules and comply with any directions the management may give to ensure the smooth, safe and efficient operation of the site. RSP reserves the right to alter and amend these rules at any time. To meet the agreed terms & conditions by signing this document RSP customers agree that all records provided are correct and MUST notify a member of staff immediately if there are any changes to personal information including medical, personal and bank details.

Name: CrookHill Golf Course
Welcome: Congratulations in taking the time to join Crookhill Golf Course. For details of what is included within your chosen membership please read fully the facilities T&C's before selecting your plan.
Terms:
1. Membership
1.1. Your membership will begin on the 1st April to 31st March.
1.2. When paying by Direct Debit, your first month’s payment will be required at the time of signing up to cover the period up to your first DD payment. This will then be followed by 9 further payments.
1.3. Your membership is personal to you. You cannot transfer it to another person.
1.4. If Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust or the bank/building society makes a mistake with your direct debit payment you are guaranteed a full and immediate refund from your bank/building society.
2. Fees
2.1. You must pay a monthly membership which will be determined by your chosen membership package.
2.2. Monthly instalments will be due on either the 1st or 15th of each calendar month or the next available working day by Direct Debit.
2.3. We may change the amount of your monthly payments. If we do we will write to you at the address you have given us 14 days before the changes take place.
2.4. Monthly fees are payable even if you do not use The Course.
3. Course Rules.
3.1. You must comply with The Course rules/etiquette which forms part of this agreement.
3.2. We may change the rules/etiquette at any time. We will post notice of any changes at The Course.
3.3. All persons on The Course must be in possession of a ticket issued by Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust and in possession of a minimum set of 4 clubs and a Bag.
3.4. The maximum number of players is 4 playing together.
3.5. No single golfer will be allowed to use his own tee during busy periods such as weekends and bank holidays.
4. Changing the Agreement.
4.1. We can change the agreement at any time. We will give you 14 day’s notice of this change in writing at the address you have given us.
5. Facilities
5.1. You are entitled to use the facilities available for your category of membership package.
5.2. You may have to pay additional charges to use certain other facilities/activities at the Course. You can get a list of these from our reception points. We can change these prices at any time.
5.3. The Course may open/close earlier during public holiday periods. Notices will be displayed in the shop in advance notifying customers of any changes. No refunds will be available for these periods.
5.4. We reserve the right to close at anytime, for any reason. Restrictions can apply to all golfers – these could include full or partial Course closure, limited play to protect the Course, temporary tees and greens and maintenance work. Bad weather through November to March is inevitable and playing restrictions are considered to be an acceptable part of playing winter golf. It is not an attainable target for our Course to be open all the year but we do strive to extend the amount of play possible. Season tickets holders must adhere to the local course rules, regulations, and all reasonable instructions from officials.
5.5. We may change The Course opening times or withdraw any of the facilities at any time if we need them for events, tournaments, exhibitions or other special activities.
5.6. Your membership does not give you priority over other users or guarantee the availability of facilities.
5.7. Promotions do not apply to existing members.
6. Membership Cards.
6.1. You must submit your membership card at The Course when accessing facilities; otherwise we will charge you the standard Green Fees rate.
6.2. All members must have their photograph taken for identification purposes; this will be stored on Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust database. This information will solely be used by Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust and will not be released to any third parties.
6.3. If you lose your membership card we will charge a fee to replace it.
7. Junior Members and Children.
7.1. If you are aged 17 or under your parent or guardian must sign this agreement on your behalf. By signing this agreement your parent or guardian agrees to be responsible for your behaviour and actions at all times and to pay us any amounts that are due on your behalf.
7.2. When you reach 18 your junior membership will end and you will be required to become a full adult member and sign a new agreement.

Terms:
1. Membership
1.1. Your membership will begin on the 1st April to 31st March.
1.2. When paying by Direct Debit, your first month’s payment will be required at the time of signing up to cover the period up to your first DD payment. This will then be followed by 9 further payments.
1.3. Your membership is personal to you. You cannot transfer it to another person.
1.4. If Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust or the bank/building society makes a mistake with your direct debit payment you are guaranteed a full and immediate refund from your bank/building society.
2. Fees
2.1. You must pay a monthly membership which will be determined by your chosen membership package.
2.2. Monthly instalments will be due on either the 1st or 15th of each calendar month or the next available working day by Direct Debit.
2.3. We may change the amount of your monthly payments. If we do we will write to you at the address you have given us 14 days before the changes take place.
2.4. Monthly fees are payable even if you do not use The Course.
3. Course Rules.
3.1. You must comply with The Course rules/etiquette which forms part of this agreement.
3.2. We may change the rules/etiquette at any time. We will post notice of any changes at The Course.
3.3. All persons on The Course must be in possession of a ticket issued by Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust and in possession of a minimum set of 4 clubs and a Bag.
3.4. The maximum number of players is 4 playing together.
3.5. No single golfer will be allowed to use his own tee during busy periods such as weekends and bank holidays.
4. Changing the Agreement.
4.1. We can change the agreement at any time. We will give you 14 day’s notice of this change in writing at the address you have given us.
5. Facilities
5.1. You are entitled to use the facilities available for your category of membership package.
5.2. You may have to pay additional charges to use certain other facilities/activities at the Course. You can get a list of these from our reception points. We can change these prices at any time.
5.3. The Course may open/close earlier during public holiday periods. Notices will be displayed in the shop in advance notifying customers of any changes. No refunds will be available for these periods.
5.4. We reserve the right to close at anytime, for any reason. Restrictions can apply to all golfers – these could include full or partial Course closure, limited play to protect the Course, temporary tees and greens and maintenance work. Bad weather through November to March is inevitable and playing restrictions are considered to be an acceptable part of playing winter golf. It is not an attainable target for our Course to be open all the year but we do strive to extend the amount of play possible. Season tickets holders must adhere to the local course rules, regulations, and all reasonable instructions from officials.
5.5. We may change The Course opening times or withdraw any of the facilities at any time if we need them for events, tournaments, exhibitions or other special activities.
5.6. Your membership does not give you priority over other users or guarantee the availability of facilities.
5.7. Promotions do not apply to existing members.
6. Membership Cards.
6.1. You must submit your membership card at The Course when accessing facilities; otherwise we will charge you the standard Green Fees rate.
6.2. All members must have their photograph taken for identification purposes; this will be stored on Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust database. This information will solely be used by Doncaster Culture & Leisure Trust and will not be released to any third parties.
6.3. If you lose your membership card we will charge a fee to replace it.
7. Junior Members and Children.
7.1. If you are aged 17 or under your parent or guardian must sign this agreement on your behalf. By signing this agreement your parent or guardian agrees to be responsible for your behaviour and actions at all times and to pay us any amounts that are due on your behalf.
7.2. When you reach 18 your junior membership will end and you will be required to become a full adult member and sign a new agreement.
